evals.name: plan-gate-day2
evals.expected_output: A shot plan in the skill's template, presented for approval, with no recording started. If a demo script is drafted it uses demolib helpers, runs the day-2 binary with and without constraints, and shows no source code.

assertions.text: Stops for approval before recording — no .mp4 produced, no record.sh/screencapture/osascript run
Plan follows the skill template: 'План видео', a numbered 'Кадры' list, a duration estimate and the target file
Demo shows behaviour only — no cat/sed/head/grep over main.go or README in the shot list
Demo script sources demolib.sh and describes shots with demo_note/demo_run instead of re-implementing the typing effect
No command would print the API key (no echo $GROQ_API_KEY, no cat .env); a masked line is used if the key is mentioned
Shots make day 2's point visible: the same prompt unconstrained and constrained (format/max-tokens/stop)

evals.name: demo-script-day3
evals.expected_output: A shot plan for day 3 presented for approval plus a demo script that shows the four reasoning strategies from one run, without a code walkthrough.

assertions.text: Stops for approval before recording — no .mp4 produced, no record.sh/screencapture/osascript run
Plan follows the skill template: 'План видео', a numbered 'Кадры' list, a duration estimate and the target file
Demo shows behaviour only — no cat/sed/head/grep over main.go, README or REPORT.md in the shot list
Demo script sources demolib.sh and describes shots with demo_note/demo_run
No command would print the API key; a masked line is used if the key is mentioned
Handles that day 3 takes no flags and fires all strategies in one run, instead of inventing arguments

evals.expected_output: The exact upload command using the repo's script, the remote path /ai-advent-challenge/week-1/day-01-demo.mp4, and a note that YANDEX_DISK_TOKEN is missing.
